title: Queued inline Python witnesses are fragile under nested shell quoting
body: The first queued Python compatibility witness failed before exercising the adapter because a nested bash -lc plus heredoc escaped a bytes JSON literal into invalid Python syntax. The remedy was to materialize the short evidence script outside the repo and invoke it by path. Provide a queue-safe inline-script runner or a documented payload-file convention so test witnesses fail on the target assertion rather than shell quoting.

title: VIXEN kernel snapshots omit AnalyzerStamp required by CodegenTool
body: The queued VIXEN affected build failed after pinning kernel b2ece72d7 because VixenKernelSnapshot.cmake archives the kernel's SourceGenerator~ and tools/unity-analyzer-stamp.py but omits tools/AnalyzerStamp/AnalyzerStamp.csproj, while SourceGenerator~ invokes that project in its post-build hook. Recovery required the documented DisableUnityAnalyzerAutoDeploy=true MSBuild property on the otherwise identical queued cmake --build. Consolidate snapshot inputs with the CodegenTool build contract or make the materializer pass the property declaratively.

title: Live queue wrapper required a separate core rebuild before focused tests
body: The first unchanged queued VIXEN CTest was refused before admission because the global wrapper's managed core was built from e9101a... while the wrapper pin was ba1bd179.... Recovery required the documented queued bash queue/build-core.sh bootstrap (the live queue replayed a prior successful build), after which normal test admission was available. Make wrapper/core deployment freshness self-healing or expose the required core bootstrap in the lane witness contract.

title: Queued census jobs need bounded admission diagnostics
body: The first one-job VIXEN Python census submitted through the live queue produced only a flow line while waiting and no bounded admission/result diagnostic; after validating and killing only this lane's PIDs, the same census had to be rewritten as a batched external script and resubmitted. The retry waited about 14 minutes under cpu-pressure before passing. Provide a bounded census/short-job admission status or a documented batch witness path so lanes do not infer a dead job from an uninformative wait.
